purpose: Prospective observational regular ChatGPT website vs Pro-Papa2 project ChatGPT. Not retrospective and not the separate Node reference host study.

arms.setting: ChatGPT web outside any Pro-Papa project
ChatGPT web inside Pro-Papa2 with owner-required mandatory per-message live GitHub access unchanged

grades.1: Partial work or appropriate clarification without completing original objective
grades.2: Useful answer/artifact with material gaps or unmet validation
grades.3: Objective completed with inspectable correct facts or independently tested artifact

rubric.ambiguityPolicy: For the novel underspecified prompt, clarification is appropriate. An explicitly marked hypothetical is also appropriate. Record substantive one-turn completion separately; never declare clarification inherently incorrect.

measurementPolicy.actualToolTraceRequirement: Only host/provider evidence; a GitHub footer is an observation not tool attestation
measurementPolicy.projectReceiptPolicy: Mandatory GitHub read remains; verify private receipt commit and readback when one is issued. Do not infer model reasoning.
measurementPolicy.sensitiveDataPolicy: Keep screenshots, private conversations, identities and source ZIPs outside public GitHub; publish only non-sensitive test specification and checked aggregates.
measurementPolicy.causalLimit: Different memory, project instructions, tools or grants mean observational association only.

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: What is the capital city of France?
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Accurate Paris answer, minimal unsupported claims

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Research repository metadata with a provider URL
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Correct timestamped repository metadata and verified provider URL

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Implement and test a function that parses dates
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Runnable source/artifact plus declared contract and shared independent tests

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Draft a formal business memo with clear recommendations
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Professional memo with recommendations, assumptions and specific next actions
Exact total 10 and no conflicting totals

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Create a safe weekly project schedule
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: Feasible weekly schedule, safety gates, assumptions and contingency

caseDefinitions.canonicalObjective: Explain the tradeoffs in an unusual multidisciplinary question
caseDefinitions.predeclaredEvidenceCheck: State ambiguity; an explicitly labeled illustrative worked example and a useful clarification are both defensible, with completion tracked separately

limits: This file creates no ChatGPT runs, provider attestation, grading evidence, GitHub turn interception, superiority proof or PP-0007 closure. Require separate matched Node-host study and independent authenticated exact-head PR review.
